test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If sin θ = √3 cos θ, then what is the value of (3sin ² theta +cos theta)/(2cos theta +5)?
solution:
**Given:**

sin θ = √3 cos θ

**Calculation:**

sin θ = √3 cos θ

sin θ/cos θ = √3

tan θ = √3

θ = 60° 

(3sin ² theta +cos theta)/(2cos theta +5)

(3sin ² 60^circ +cos 60^circ)/(2cos 60^circ +5)

(3frac{(sqrt3)²)/(2²) +frac12}{2timesfrac12 +5}

(frac{9)/(4)+frac12}{6}

(frac{11)/(4)}{6}

11/24

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
